periods.heading: January 1 to January 25 — Jupiter in Leo (5th House)
body: The year begins with Jupiter in your 5th house, bringing an encouraging start for creativity, confidence, education, romance, and personal expression. You may feel more motivated to pursue something that genuinely excites you, whether it involves learning, a creative project, or an important personal goal. Relationships can feel warmer, while matters connected with children may also receive greater attention. However, increased confidence can sometimes make you expect quick results, so keeping your decisions practical will be important. Jupiter’s 5th aspect on your 9th house supports higher learning, travel, spiritual growth, and a broader outlook toward life. Its 7th aspect on your 11th house can strengthen your social circle, professional networks, and long-term ambitions, helping you connect with people who support your growth. Jupiter’s 9th aspect on your 1st house boosts confidence, optimism, and personal development. This opening phase encourages you to trust your abilities while remaining thoughtful about where you invest your energy.

periods.heading: January 25 to June 26 — Jupiter in Cancer (4th House)
body: As Jupiter moves back into your 4th house, your attention turns toward home, family, emotional security, property, and inner stability. Because Jupiter is retrograde during this phase, you may find yourself revisiting matters that require greater emotional understanding rather than immediate action. Family responsibilities may increase, old conversations could return, or you may reconsider decisions connected with your home and living environment. This can also be a meaningful period for rebuilding emotional security and resolving issues that have remained unsettled. Jupiter’s 5th aspect on your 8th house encourages deeper transformation and can help you understand hidden fears, shared financial matters, or patterns that need to change. Its 7th aspect on your 10th house keeps career matters active, although professional progress may require patience, reassessment, or a change in strategy. Jupiter’s 9th aspect on your 12th house supports introspection, spiritual development, rest, and emotional release. Rather than forcing outward expansion, this period helps you strengthen your foundation before the year becomes more externally progressive.

Jupiter’s 5th aspect on your 9th house expands opportunities connected with higher education, travel, mentors, spiritual understanding, and new experiences. Its 7th aspect on your 11th house strengthens friendships, networking, gains, and long-term aspirations. Jupiter’s 9th aspect on your 1st house supports confidence, personal growth, and a stronger sense of direction. This is one of the more expansive periods of the year, encouraging you to express yourself openly while turning meaningful ambitions into achievable goals.

The year closes by encouraging you to convert growth into discipline, creating stronger routines and practical stability for the year ahead.
